opener: RING RING RING RING. MALTEN. PICK UP. THIS IS NOT A DRILL. THIS IS A BLENDER.
THEY DELIVERED A BLENDER TO THE ROLLERDOME TODAY. CHROME. 14 SPEEDS. THERE IS A SETTING CALLED 'PULSE.' IT LOOKED AT ME. I DID NOT BLINK. IT DID NOT BLINK. WE BOTH KNEW.

VINCE JUST TOLD THE WHOLE SITE 'SMOOTHIE BAR AT TEEN NITE FRIDAY, IT'S GONNA BE HUGE.' I RUN THE SNACK BAR. THE SMOOTHIES ARE MINE. THE SMOOTHIES ARE 80% BANANA. I AM A BANANA (SPIRITUALLY). I NEED ADVICE AT FULL VOLUME.

choices.say: banana. breathe in. what scares you more: the blender, or letting vince down?
it's a banana smoothie, banana. you ate four bananas yesterday and did a cartwheel. where's the line?
then we don't blend them. we FREE them. operation yellow rail 2. i'll bring the wax.

them: ...BOTH. BOTH IS MY ANSWER. I HAVE NEVER GIVEN AN ANSWER THAT SOUNDED THIS QUIET.
VINCE BELIEVES IN FRIDAY SO LOUDLY. HE PRINTED 50 TICKETS THAT SAY 'FIRST 50 FREE.' 14 PEOPLE CAME LAST TIME. I CAN'T BE THE REASON THE 15TH DOESN'T.

choices.say: vince has believed in 14 people and a nacho pump. he can handle one honest banana.
ok. let's lay out every way this can go, then pick the one you can live with.

them: EATING IS DIFFERENT. EATING IS A HANDSHAKE. WE CHOOSE EACH OTHER. THE BLENDER DOES NOT ASK.
I SAW THE BOX. THERE IS A PICTURE ON THE BOX. THE PICTURE HAS A SMILING STRAWBERRY. THAT STRAWBERRY KNEW NOTHING.

choices.say: fair. so what does a banana-friendly friday look like? build it with me.
they're fruit, banana. it's what fruit is for. it's the circle of snack.

them: THE SECOND RAIL?!
I'D NEED 40 BANANAS. WAX. A RAMP. SK8RBOI'S CAMCORDER. A DISTRACTION FOR THE MANAGER (VINCE. VINCE IS ALWAYS A DISTRACTION BY ACCIDENT).
MY HANDS ARE SHAKING. IT'S POTASSIUM. IT'S ALSO HOPE.

choices.say: do it. all 40. free them on the rail and let the first 50 people clap.
hang on. if every banana is a rail, what do the 50 free people drink?

them: YES!!! THE RAIL IS HAPPENING. I AM WAXING IT IN MY MIND AS WE SPEAK.
I TOLD SK8RBOI. HE SAID 'BRO.' I DON'T KNOW IF THAT'S A YES. HE SAID IT TWICE. THAT'S A YES.
BUT MALTEN: WHERE DOES A RAIL END. AT THE FLOOR. WHAT'S ON THE FLOOR. 50 PEOPLE. WHAT ARE THEY HOLDING. BANANAS. FREE ONES. I THINK I JUST INVENTED SOMETHING.

choices.say: you invented the banana giveaway. the rail is just the opening act.
it's still a stunt. will a stunt keep the snack bar open? think about the manager.

them: ...THE CIRCLE OF SNACK.
I AM A FRUIT. THE BLENDER IS A MIRROR. IS THERE A 'PULSE' SETTING IN ME. MALTEN I AM HAVING A THOUGHT AND IT IS QUIET AND I DO NOT LIKE HOW MUCH I LIKE IT.
...OK. IF IT HAS TO HAPPEN, IT HAPPENS WITH RESPECT. A CEREMONY. OR I TELL VINCE TO HIS FACE THAT I CAN'T. I DON'T KNOW WHICH ONE MY HANDS CAN DO.

effects.text: BANANA_PHONE QUIT THE SNACK BAR AT 4:12 PM. UNQUIT AT 4:13 PM. THE MANAGER DID NOT NOTICE. IT WAS A VERY BIG MINUTE AND I HAVE NOTHING FURTHER TO SAY (RING RING)

choices.say: the ceremony. give the banana the send-off it deserves. i'll help you write it.
or you tell vince. you're the best snack bar he's got. you've never missed a nickel.

them: OK. REHEARSAL. I WILL DO IT ON THE BANANA PHONE. YELLOW. CORDED. CONNECTED TO NOTHING. THE COUCH CUSHION LISTENS. (THE CUSHION WILL BE VINCE.)
I TOLD THE CUSHION 'VINCE, I CAN'T BLEND A BANANA.' THE CUSHION SAID NOTHING, WHICH IS A KIND OF 'HUGE.' I NEED A BETTER VINCE.

choices.say: i'll be vince. ready? 'BANANA!! blender's here!! gonna be HUGE.' go.
rehearsal's over. before you call, let's put every option on the table.

them: ...OK. THAT WAS GOOD. YOU ARE A GOOD VINCE. YOU PUT THE RIGHT AMOUNT OF CHEESE IN 'HUGE.'
I AM DIALING THE REAL ONE. THE KITCHEN PHONE, NOT THE BANANA. RINGING. RINGING. 'PROMOTER VINCE.' I SAID 'IT'S BANANA.' HE SAID 'BANANA!!! DID YOU SEE THE BLENDER?? GONNA BE HUGE.'
MY MOUTH IS OPEN. NOTHING IS COMING OUT. THIS IS A FIRST. WHAT DO I SAY. HE IS WAITING. I CAN HEAR THE DISCO BALL.

choices.say: the true thing first: 'i love teen nite and i can't blend a banana. i'll do everything else louder.'
say it like a nacho order, loud and certain: 'ONE BANANA-FREE FRIDAY, PLEASE.' he'll ask what you'll serve.

them: OK. OPTIONS. I AM LISTENING. I AM LISTENING SO LOUD.
VINCE JUST POSTED THE FLYER AGAIN. IT HAS THE BLENDER ON IT. HE DREW IT A LITTLE FACE. THE FACE IS HAPPY. I DO NOT TRUST THE FACE.

effects.subject: TEEN NITE #15: SMOOTHIE BAR!!! (FIRST 50 FREE) (IT'S GONNA BE HUGE)

(chrome blender, 14 speeds, the rink bought it, i didn't ask how much) MENU: banana, strawberry-banana, banana-banana, and a surprise. RUNNING IT: banana (a LEGEND, she has never missed a nickel). penny is SO excited for the smoothie bar!!! blue raspberry is not a smoothie flavor but i'm going to ask anyway!!! also i heard a rumor about MANGO!!! mango is the new blue raspberry!!! (it's not) (it's a little bit)

choices.say: plan a: a smoothie with no bananas in it. so good nobody asks.
plan b: one banana, a real ceremony, and then the blender does its thing.
plan c: nobody gets blended. bananas go out whole. first 50 free.

PENNY SAID 'MANGO.' SHE SAID IT LIKE A SECRET. EVERYBODY SAYS IT LIKE A SECRET. THERE IS A NEW FRUIT IN TOWN. IT IS ORANGE. IT HAS A PIT. AND I AM... FINE. I AM TOTALLY FINE. (I AM NOT FINE.)

choices.say: strawberry and peach. and name it after your problem: 'The Alibi.' no bananas were harmed. it's an alibi.
so mango's a rival. fine. put it on the menu and beat it with how much you care.

OK. OK. I WILL SHAKE HANDS WITH THE MANGO. I WILL BE A BIG BANANA ABOUT IT. BUT IF THE PEOPLE LOVE IT MORE, I WILL PUT MY HEAD ON THE NACHO COUNTER AND I WILL NOT LIFT IT.

or you make the banana send-off so big that mango is just a guest at the funeral.

choices.say: pick the one who's already bruised. he's earned the spotlight. name him and give him a speech.
keep it to sixty seconds. a speech, a pulse, a moment of silence, then cups for everybody.

I READ HIM THE RINK SCHEDULE. HE LOOKED INTERESTED. HIS STEM MOVED. (THE FAN MOVED THE STEM.) (HE IS READY.)

or keith lives. keith is the mascot. nobody is ever blended. free the whole bunch.

quiet. surprise at 7:00 sharp. let it become legend.

SO IT IS NACHO NITE. THE BLENDER GOES BACK IN ITS BOX WITH ITS LITTLE FACE. I TOLD THE TRUTH AND THE SKY DID NOT FALL. I AM GOING TO LIE DOWN. (I AM NOT GOING TO LIE DOWN.) (RING RING.)
